thesis: Spec renders and passes the gate.

blocks.topic_sentence: Spec-driven prose passes the measurement gate when paragraph blocks are concise and varied.

claims.claim: The Coleman-Liau index lands in the correct readability band for technical content.
Sentence length alternates enough to satisfy the standard deviation requirement.
Few word pairs repeat, keeping the bigram repetition percentage below the limit.

blocks.stake: This test runs every prose metric against real rendered output.
